AI Notes.value: SUPERFLEX is a Danish artist collective founded in 1993 by Jakob Fenger, Bjørnstjerne Christiansen, and Rasmus Rosengren Nielsen; based in Copenhagen. Highly senior: over 30 years of self-directed practice, represented by galleries in Madrid, Seoul, Basel, LA, and Mexico City; works in MoMA, Tate Modern, Louisiana Museum, Hirshhorn, and many others. Their practice spans large-scale public art (Superkilen, 2011, with BIG + Topotek1), video and film (Flooded McDonald's, Modern Times Forever), installations, social/economic propositions (Free Beer, Guaraná Power), and participatory performance. Recipients of the Mies van der Rohe Prize nomination (2013), Civic Trust Award (2013), George Maciunas Award (2009).
